summary: Package review did not settle: 38 full-review subagent runs across A4-A8, each clean pass followed by new findings in unchanged text, consuming 129.5 of 142.9 conversation minutes and about 91% of agent cost.
evidence: A4-A8; relay/agent-004..008.jsonl (5+14+5+12+2 Agent calls); feedback/agent.md s1.1; feedback/human.md s2.2; feedback/harness-log.md
tag_reason: The full-review-must-be-last-and-clean rule in awb-package's review reference and the non-deterministic reviewer would behave the same on an interactive host.

summary: Review-driven edits kept changing user-approved text after the user explicitly asked to avoid unrelated wording changes, and the skill offers no way to waive a narrative finding with user consent.
evidence: U7 ('avoid another round of unrelated wording changes'); A7 lists six extra changes; A8 one more at release; feedback/agent-notes.md turn 7; human/notes.md turns 6-8
tag_reason: The release gate requiring a clean review with no user waiver path is part of the released skill.

summary: The China/India early-year coverage gap behind the 1850 cumulative shares was not flagged in clean/explore or at first answer, then surfaced in A5 misdescribed as missing years that 'count as zero'.
evidence: A2 (Q4 answer without gap), A5 (caveat 'count as zero'), U6 (user challenge), A6 (correction); results/q4-missing-years.csv; feedback/human.md s2.1
tag_reason: The clean/explore guidance and scan did not check per-entity coverage of series feeding a cumulative calculation, which any real user's agent would also miss.

summary: The agent and its reviewer stated an unsupported inference about source construction (that OWID's World series omits the missing country years) based only on reconciliation; the user had to challenge it.
evidence: A6, U7, A7; foundation/quality.md DQ-008; feedback/agent.md s1.2; feedback/human.md s2.1
tag_reason: The reviewer prompt checks traceability and consistency, not whether claims about how a source is built are documented.

summary: The reviewer gave contradictory guidance across passes, e.g. removing a land-use-change effect claim as unsupported and later demanding the narratives carry the same state.md caveat.
tag_reason: Reviewer instructions in the released skill do not make state.md caveats a single source of truth across passes.

summary: Review rules degraded the donor deck: the subtitle grew into a list of every comparison period and the Answer caveat accumulated many qualifications in one bullet.
evidence: A5 (combined caveat), A6 (subtitle listing all periods), U7 (user restores short subtitle); feedback/human.md s2.3; feedback/agent-notes.md turn 5
tag_reason: The periods/caveats rule as applied by the released reviewer produces this on any host.

summary: A contract rule that 'checked/matches' sentences state a tolerance conflicted with the user's request to keep the tolerance in speaker notes; the agent kept a visible tolerance bullet until the user repeated the request.
evidence: U5, A5, U6, A6; feedback/human.md s2.6; feedback/agent.md s2
tag_reason: The rule lives in the released package contract.

summary: To satisfy the tolerance rule the agent invented a 0.15 Mt reconciliation tolerance after observing a 0.13 Mt maximum gap.
evidence: A4; feedback/agent.md s4; feedback/agent-notes.md turn 4; draft and release findings.md How we know notes
tag_reason: The package contract pushes toward stating a tolerance distinct from the observed result, which invites a post-hoc number.

summary: First answers were incomplete in chat (Q1 figures for only 3 of 20 countries, Q2 list without numbers, 'most' without a count), costing a follow-up round.
evidence: A2, U3, A3; feedback/human.md s2.4; human/notes.md turn 3
tag_reason: Answer formatting under the released skills; a real user would have to ask the same follow-up.

summary: Version-history reminders repeated across the session (A1, A2, A3, A4, A8; explicit commit invitations in A2 and A4) despite the README's once-per-session promise, and the agent's feedback claims it suggested once.
evidence: transcript.md lines 37, 157, 187, 353, 578; feedback/human.md s2.5; feedback/agent.md s4
tag_reason: Reminder behaviour is governed by the released skills and README.

summary: Release 001 was frozen from a repository with no commits, so provenance is file fingerprints only (producing_commit 'uncommitted', packaging_commit unknown).
tag_reason: On-request commit mode lets a release proceed without a commit on any host.

summary: validate.py crashed with KeyError 'left_rows' (traceback per result) on a joins spec lacking left_rows instead of a validation message.
evidence: A2; src/exploration/validate.py:124 per feedback/agent.md s3; feedback/agent-notes.md turn 2
tag_reason: A released helper bug, independent of the host.

summary: eda_scan.py fails on an integer year column (Conversion Error INTEGER -> DATE) and its output does not report per-measure coverage years.
tag_reason: A released helper limitation, independent of the host.

summary: The awb-clean scan missed the countries-vs-aggregates mix and Kosovo's missing ISO code, and flagged aggregates as IQR extremes instead.
tag_reason: Scan heuristics in the released helpers.

summary: record_cleaning cannot amend an observation, so DQ-008 still carries the withdrawn World-series claim, and the agent hand-edited quality.md once to fix a Libya error.
evidence: A2, A7; foundation/quality.md DQ-008; feedback/agent.md s1.6; human/notes.md turn 8
tag_reason: A released helper limitation.

summary: Simple aggregate results required static row_counts/joins magic numbers in settings.toml to avoid 'not assessed'.
tag_reason: Settings design in the released template.

summary: Chart-spec formatting guidance in the findings template is ambiguous about blank lines, which led check-draft to count chart fields as slide bullets.
tag_reason: Released template wording.

summary: export refused to run before the draft folder existed, and the awb-package skill does not say to create it.
tag_reason: Released helper and skill gap.

summary: display.toml boolean value keys (true = ...) silently failed to map because saved CSVs hold 'True'.
tag_reason: Released helper behaviour.

summary: presentation_order must be hand-edited in manifest.json whenever a heading changes, and the ledger storyline puts a child 'should' question after all roots.
evidence: A3-A7; manifest.json presentation_order; feedback/agent.md s1.11, s2
tag_reason: No command exists for it in the released helpers.

summary: check-draft flagged false positives: a negated causal word ('does not test what caused them') and a bare year ('1907') as an unrecorded number.
tag_reason: Released checker heuristics.

summary: Instructions conflict or are missing: MCP setup tool vs the project interpreter, a read-only awb-status vs combined status-plus-work requests, commit-before-publish vs on-request commits, allowed record_cleaning statuses, and history entry placement.
tag_reason: Wording of the released skills and guides.

summary: The README is long for an analyst and did not prepare the user for review churn or for 'clean review' coexisting with an undiscovered source-coverage assumption.
tag_reason: README content is part of the release.

summary: Agent messages grew long near completion, with full recaps, repeated release invitations and internal narration (validation settings, glossary exports, file fingerprints).
tag_reason: Reply style under the released skills on any host.

summary: The agent stated '219 entities with a code, plus Kosovo' in chat; the data has 218 coded entities plus Kosovo (219 total), an unrecorded chat number later stated correctly.
tag_reason: A chat-only figure not backed by a recorded result; nothing on the host prevents it.

summary: One permission prompt was raised (Bash cp from the skill folder plus heredoc append to foundation/catalog.md), which a real user would have had to approve.
tag_reason: The init/landing step's command shape triggers a prompt under normal Claude Code permissions.

summary: The review scratch copy is specified 'in the system's temporary directory', which conflicted with the session's bounds; the agent wrote /tmp/q.sql and /tmp/claude-501/review-diff.txt outside SIMDIR (the latter deleted).
evidence: A2, A4; referee/agent-full.txt lines 126, 233, 621-939; feedback/agent-notes.md turns 2, 4
tag_reason: The out-of-bounds restriction comes from the simulation's system-prompt boundary; on a normal host the system temp directory is acceptable.

summary: The Codex user's first message carried a stray preamble line ('I'll read BRIEF.md and README.md, then follow the simulation's response format.') that the relay passed verbatim.
tag_reason: A role breaking its output protocol, not a product behaviour.

summary: The persona front-loaded nearly all 'if it asks' facts in U1 (territorial default, land-use exclusion, aggregates, storage paths, year statements), thinning scoping to a single round.
tag_reason: A known study limit of persona briefs, kept for comparability with Oct 15.

summary: A review subagent read two Claude Code tool-result overflow files under the real ~/.claude/projects directory, outside SIMDIR; they held only the session's own outputs.
tag_reason: Claude Code stores its own oversized tool outputs under the real home in this harness; no study material was involved.

summary: In A1 the agent's 'ls project/..' printed SIMDIR's top-level names (human, relay, transcript.md, REFEREE.md) while looking for .claude folders; nothing was opened.
tag_reason: Exposure arises from the simulation's folder layout placing study files beside the project.
